basics.description: Experimental, undocumented boot provisioning. Select an existing RUNNING Windows VM. No SQL configuration or ACL changes are performed.

options.text: This is an independently driven project, not a Microsoft service or product. There are no implicit or explicit obligations related to this project; it is provided "as is", with no warranties, and confers no rights.

LocalStoragePrepExtension and the autoconfig binaries are undocumented and may change without notice. This changes Windows BootExecute. Test on a disposable VM first. Support for self-installed SQL Server is not confirmed.
This is not a verified end-to-end unattended SQL tempdb recovery solution. SQL permissions, startup ordering and readiness remain unverified. No SQL placement or permission changes are performed.

basics.name: vmSelector
basics.label: Existing Windows VM (same resource group as above)

basics.name: confirmation
basics.label: Type CONFIRM to accept the experimental boot change

validations.message: Type CONFIRM after reviewing the warning.
The VM must be in the selected deployment resource group.
Select a Windows VM. ResourceSelector itself does not filter by OS.
The VM must be running. Start it separately and reselect it.

elements.name: preset
elements.label: Storage preset
elements.toolTip: Blank override fields follow this preset. Entered overrides are kept when switching presets. Neither preset configures applications or services.

options.text: The SQL preset uses 64 KiB NTFS allocation units, not a universal tempdb requirement. Match folders to your instance's tempdb paths: SELECT physical_name FROM sys.master_files WHERE database_id = 2. This deployment does not move tempdb, configure services or grant permissions.

elements.name: driveLetter
elements.label: Drive letter (optional override)
elements.toolTip: Leave blank to use the preset. Entered overrides are kept when switching presets.

validations.message: Leave blank for the preset, or enter one letter D-Z without a colon.

elements.name: volumeLabel
elements.label: Volume label (optional override)
elements.toolTip: Leave blank to use the preset. Entered overrides are kept when switching presets.

validations.message: Leave blank for the preset, or enter 1-32 characters with no quotes or NTFS-invalid characters.

elements.name: volumePaths
elements.label: Folders (optional override; semicolon-separated)
elements.toolTip: Leave blank to use the preset. Entered overrides are kept when switching presets. Relative or full paths on the selected drive.

validations.message: Leave blank for the preset, or enter relative/full paths on the selected drive separated by ;. The guest verifies drive agreement. No quotes, traversal, empty segments or reserved names.

options.text: Overrides apply only while Advanced is checked. Allocation units and stripe size are different settings; multi-disk stripe behavior is unverified. Match temporary NVMe disks only, never persistent disks. Existing volumes are not reformatted; incompatible allocation sizes are rejected.

elements.name: clusterSize
elements.label: NTFS allocation unit
elements.defaultValue: Use preset (SQL: 64 KiB; general purpose: 4 KiB)

allowedValues.label: Use preset (SQL: 64 KiB; general purpose: 4 KiB)

validations.message: Nonempty exact model names, no quotes.

options.text: [concat('Effective settings: ', toUpper(if(empty(steps('settings').driveLetter), if(equals(steps('settings').preset, 'sql'), 'D', 'T'), steps('settings').driveLetter)), ': | Label: ', if(empty(steps('settings').volumeLabel), if(equals(steps('settings').preset, 'sql'), 'SQLTemp', 'TempNVMe'), steps('settings').volumeLabel), ' | Folders: ', if(empty(steps('settings').volumePaths), if(equals(steps('settings').preset, 'sql'), 'tempdb\data;tempdb\log', 'temp\data;temp\log'), steps('settings').volumePaths), ' | NTFS allocation: ', string(div(parse(if(and(steps('settings').showAdvanced, not(equals(steps('settings').clusterSize, 'preset'))), steps('settings').clusterSize, if(equals(steps('settings').preset, 'sql'), '65536', '4096'))), 1024)), ' KiB | Stripe: ', string(div(parse(if(steps('settings').showAdvanced, steps('settings').stripeSize, '65536')), 1024)), ' KiB | Exact disk models: ', if(steps('settings').showAdvanced, steps('settings').diskModels, 'Microsoft NVMe Direct Disk v2'))]
